title: rec-c1-7-projection-authority-acceptance
summary: REC-C1.7 makes QueryEngine a reconstructible projection of SessionExecutionLog — the only canonical builder is chronos_services::projection::build_engine, and execution_query / state_query / trace_slice refuse to answer when the projection is Truncated. Closes TRUTH-001 (partial → verified). Adds the public C1-01 (two consumers, real MCP wire) and C1-05 (uncorrelated seq/event_id/timestamp_ns) UATs, plus a restart-equivalence UAT that proves canonical queries survive an in-memory wipe. Does NOT remove EventBus / drain_raw_events / fired_buffer / TripwireFired — those are owned by REC-C2 after the C1.8 handoff.
notes: Cycle planning commit (C1.7.0) lands first. Sub-deliverables per tasks.md: C1.7.1 RED characterization (dual-truth divergence), C1.7.2 GREEN projection::build_engine + 5 unit tests, C1.7.3 wire projection into MCP + gate canonical operations, C1.7.4 restart-equivalence UAT, C1.7.5 public C1-01 UAT, C1.7.6 time-semantics UAT, C1.7.7 TRUTH-001 ratchet. CC#39 pre-existing drift grows from 1 to 2 (this cycle's index entry); remains pre-existing, intentionally surfaced. CC#11, CC#13 expected PASS at closure.
